gather-remedy-material.title: Gather remedy ingredients
gather-remedy-material.definition: Catch, take or gather a named animal, plant or substance for a medical prescription.

crush-material.title: Crush remedy ingredients
crush-material.definition: Crush or grind named ingredients for a remedy.

mix-remedy.title: Mix a remedy
mix-remedy.definition: Combine named ingredients with a liquid, flour or other base, including steeping and sifting.

expose-overnight.title: Leave out overnight
expose-overnight.definition: Leave a prepared liquid or remedy outdoors or on the roof overnight, under the stars.

give-remedy.title: Administer a remedy
give-remedy.definition: Give a prepared remedy to the patient to drink or eat, with any stated timing.

apply-compress.title: Apply a compress
apply-compress.definition: Heat a compress or pad and apply it to the patient.

carry-remedy.title: Carry a remedy
carry-remedy.definition: Move a prepared remedy from one place to another.
